purpose: The live site's comparison matrix as data: row definitions plus per-product cells. Lets a report renderer draw cited capability dots for a scoped set of products instead of improvising cell values from raw claims.
reading_rules: Rows without an explicit kind are state cells; kind=text cells carry a short value string instead of a state.
State cell values: s=supported, u=unsupported, k=unknown, n=not applicable. k means not established — never render or reason about it as a negative.
A cell's claimId resolves to a claim in that product's pack file; cite it (with reviewer_status) whenever the cell backs a verdict. A cell without a claimId licenses nothing.
remote_support maps remote_routes ids to the same state values.

compare_page_status describes the live site's compare page only: deep-link (url_templates.compare_preselect) ignores deferred and inactive ids. Cells of deferred products remain fully usable in a report.
This matrix is a subset of the claim ledger, not a second source of truth. On any conflict, the claim rows in products/*.json win.
